title: 第七章拜神教第八章五禽拳
content_zh:
;;
大街上，江宁的眼神突然一凝，看着前方。
前方赫然是一支敲锣打鼓的队伍。
“大哥，这是？”江宁眼中透露出疑惑。
江黎略微打量了一番，看到熟悉的标志后，随即开口：“这应该是拜神教的在民间的信徒，这是去城隍庙祭祀神灵祈福。”
江宁神色顿显诧异：“拜神教？拜神教不是被衙门剿杀的对象吗？怎么会去城隍庙祭祀祈福？”
江黎摇摇头：“我也不清楚，按上头的意思，大致就是普通信徒不用管，剿杀拜神教的教徒才是任务。”
听到这番话，江宁不由的暗暗摇头。
如此方式，怎么可能压的下拜神教，这种纵容的态度只会让拜神教越演越烈。
教会的强大力量他再了解不过。
在前世的历史已经无数次表明了教会的强大。
不论是席卷东汉末年的黄巾之乱，还是清朝末年的太平天国运动，都表现出了教会恐怖的力量。
即使在那个文明发达，科技先进的社会，也遥远的西方同样存在着那个世界第一大教，同样有无数狂信徒。
在这个世界，或许曾经有过神灵存在的世界，也有超凡力量的世界，所以任何教会都将会变得更加可怕，汇聚人心和力量的程度也会倍增。
江宁也不信洛水县的三大家和县尊不会不知道如此纵容拜神教的危害。
此时此刻，他对于自己之前的判断以及徐云峰说的那番话所透露出来的信息更是确信无疑。
如今的洛水县分明是过江龙在和地头蛇的斗争。
而大哥大嫂这一家以及自己都卷入了这场斗争。
对于县尊的重情重义他完全不敢有任何寄托，所以他明白自己要想从这個漩涡中跳出，那就必须要寻找第三方。
驻扎在洛水县之外的王都头便是那个第三方，手握兵权，是他作壁上观的底气根源。

如今自己要想借他的势跳出这个漩涡，同时拯救大哥大嫂这一家，那就只能依靠沧浪武馆王进的关系。
两者皆姓王，有着血亲关系。
自己只要通过沧浪武馆的考验，成为武馆真正弟子，那就有资格借势。
“一切只希望面板足够神奇！”他在心中暗暗自语。
......
随即，俩人与那支汇聚了拜神教信徒的队伍擦肩而过，然后沿着宽阔的大道径直朝着内城走去。
半个时辰后，因为有江黎捕快的身份，两人畅通无阻的就穿过隔着内城和外城的城墙，进入了洛水县的内城。
在洛水县，有着内城和外城之分，外城居住的一般都是贩夫走卒这种平民，治安环境比较乱。
而内城则不同，五丈之高的内城城墙，把内外城分成了两个世界。
内城居住的人非富即贵，治安因此也远超外城，沧浪武馆即是在内城。
一入内城，江宁便感觉仿佛来到了一个新的世界。
四通八达的道路两侧布满了高耸粗壮的大树和交相辉映的花圃。
就连空气中都传来淡淡的花香，道路更是干净宽阔，可供五辆马车并驾齐驱。
“去沧浪武馆！”
俩人坐上一驾马车，江黎掏出十文钱对着车夫说道。
“好的，爷！”车夫哈腰点头。
下一刻，马车带着两人飞驰在内城之中。
足足过了一炷香的功夫，马车才缓缓的在一栋大院面前停了下来。

On the street, Jiang Ning's eyes suddenly froze and he looked ahead.
Ahead was a team beating gongs and drums.
"Brother, what is this?" Jiang Ning had doubts in his eyes.
Jiang Li looked around for a while, and after seeing a familiar sign, he immediately said: "These should be the folk believers of the God Worship Sect. They are going to the City God's Temple to offer sacrifices to the gods and pray for blessings."
Jiang Ning suddenly looked surprised: "The God-Worship Cult? Isn't the God-Worship Cult the target of being suppressed by the Yamen? How come you go to the City God's Temple to offer sacrifices and pray for blessings?"
Jiang Li shook his head: "I don't know either. According to what the superiors mean, it's roughly that ordinary believers don't need to worry about it. The mission is to kill the believers of the god-worshipping sect."
Hearing these words, Jiang Ning couldn't help but shook his head secretly.
How could it be possible to suppress the God-Worship Cult in this way? This conniving attitude would only make the God-Worship Cult become more and more intense.
He knew only too well the power of the Church.
The history of the past life has demonstrated countless times how powerful the church is.
Whether it was the Yellow Turban Rebellion that swept through the late Eastern Han Dynasty or the Taiping Rebellion in the late Qing Dynasty, they all demonstrated the terrifying power of the church.
Even in that society with developed civilization and advanced technology, the world's largest religion still exists in the far west, and it also has countless fanatical believers.
In this world, there may have been a world where gods existed and a world where extraordinary power existed, so any church will become more terrifying, and the degree of gathering people's hearts and power will also double.
Jiang Ning also didn't believe that the three major families in Luoshui County and the county magistrate would not know the dangers of such indulgence in worshiping gods.
At this moment, he was even more convinced of his previous judgment and the information revealed by Xu Yunfeng's words.
Today's Luoshui County is clearly a struggle between the dragon crossing the river and the local snake.
The family of the eldest brother, sister-in-law and myself are all involved in this struggle.
He didn't dare to have any faith in the county's respect for love and justice, so he knew that if he wanted to jump out of this vortex, he had to find a third party.
Wang Dutou, who is stationed outside Luoshui County, is the third party. He holds military power and is the source of his confidence to sit on the sidelines.
Now if I want to use his strength to jump out of this whirlpool and save the family of my eldest brother and sister-in-law, I can only rely on the relationship with Wang Jin of Canglang Martial Arts School.
Both have the surname Wang and are related by blood.
As long as he passes the test of Canglang Martial Arts School and becomes a true disciple of the Martial Arts School, he will be qualified to take advantage of the situation.
"I just hope the panel is magical enough!" He secretly said to himself.
...
Immediately, the two people passed by the team that gathered believers of the God Worship Cult, and then walked straight towards the inner city along the wide avenue.
Half an hour later, because of Jiang Li's identity as an agent, the two of them passed through the wall that separated the inner city and the outer city without any hindrance and entered the inner city of Luoshui County.
In Luoshui County, there are inner cities and outer cities. The outer cities are generally inhabited by civilians such as traffickers and foot soldiers, and the public security environment is relatively chaotic.
The inner city is different. The five-foot-high inner city wall divides the inner and outer cities into two worlds.
The people living in the inner city are either rich or noble, so the public security is far better than that in the outer city. Canglang Martial Arts School is located in the inner city.
As soon as he entered the inner city, Jiang Ning felt as if he had entered a new world.
The roads extending in all directions are lined with tall and thick trees and flower beds.
There is a faint fragrance of flowers in the air, and the road is clean and wide enough for five carriages to drive side by side.
"Go to Canglang Martial Arts School!"
The two of them got into a carriage. Jiang Li took out ten coins and said to the coachman.
"Okay, sir!" The coachman bowed and nodded.
The next moment, the carriage took the two of them speeding through the inner city.
After a full stick of incense, the carriage slowly stopped in front of a large courtyard.
